newsitem.title: UK: Italy bond seen at 100 bln yen, 20 years -dealers.
newsitem.headline: Italy bond seen at 100 bln yen, 20 years -dealers.

text.p: Italy's long-term yen Eurobond, plans for which were announced earlier by the Italian Treasury, is expected to be a 100 billion yen 20-year deal, syndicate managers said on Monday.
Officials at Nikko Europe, bookrunner for the deal, declined to comment on the terms of the transaction. Traders at other banks said the deal was likely to be launched on Tuesday.
Spread talk was around 20 basis points over long-dated JGBs, dealers said, which would result in a coupon of 3.45 to 3.50 percent, dealers said.
Italy launched a 100 billion yen 20-year bond last October via Nomura Securities. The deal paid a 3.70 percent coupon.
